images.title: Close angles look alike
images.purpose: Show that angles with nearly the same opening look alike, so we must overlap or measure to be sure.
images.composition: Two angles side by side, almost the same opening, with a question mark between.
images.exact_structure: Left: an angle with equal arms in teal #0072B2. Right: an angle with equal arms in amber #E69F00 and an opening only slightly different from the left one. Between them, a reddish purple #CC79A7 question mark. Exactly 2 angles, 1 question mark, all 4 arms equal length.

images.description: Two nearly identical angles, teal and amber, with a purple question mark between them.
